messages:
Maya (PM): quick thread  customer Z asked for a "Burst Priority" add-on: guarantees P95 route latency <120ms during customer-specified peak windows. can we scope pricing & risks?
Ibrahim (SRE): need to define: is guarantee cross-tenant (shared pools) or per-customer reserved warm capacity?
Jules (Sales): customer expects predictable performance during their marketing spikes. willing to pay fixed monthly + usage uplift.
Priya (Finance): propose we model two pricing levers: fixed monthly addon + per-peak-hour tokens. need ARR uplift calc and credit policy.
Maya (PM): constraints: - available on Dedicated & Private only - opt-in per-route or global app-level - pilot gating for Q3 launch.
Ibrahim (SRE): implementation notes: VIP tagging at ingress, fast-path routing to warm instances, optional KV cache pinning for session affinity. warm pools add idle GPU cost.
Notify-bot: infra alert: experiment warm-pool-3 increased idle GPU by 7% last week (see /infra/ops/exp-3).
Jules (Sales): customer wants SLA-like language. Suggest credit = 1.5x monthly addon for each month with >0.5% breach, capped.
Owen (Legal): caps are good. limit total credits to 40% of addon revenue annually. add force majeure carveouts. require precise metric definition and arbitration window.
Priya (Finance): billing automation is mandatory. estimate 1 sprint for hooks if telemetry is standard. need clear revenue recognition treatment for addon.
Ibrahim (SRE): dev estimate: 5 sprints MLP for shared-warm implementation with metrics; 9-12 sprints for per-customer reserved pools + provisioning flows.
Maya (PM): launch checklist (draft): 1) telemetry & metric spec for P95 by-route 2) billing integration & automated credit calc 3) pilot agreement template + legal addendum 4) ops runbook for spike handling 5) sales playbook and pricing sheet.
Jules (Sales): pilot ask: 3 customers across tiers; success criteria: sustained P95 <120ms during 3 separate scheduled peaks and <1.4x cost uplift.
Ibrahim (SRE): risk: shared pools may slightly increase tail for non-priority traffic. mitigation: configurable isolation levels and throttling for VIPs.
Maya (PM): decision needed: require reserved pools for customers paying >$400k ARR vs shared pools for smaller customers. Tradeoffs below.
Maya (PM): Tradeoff X: Shared pools -> faster launch, lower price, more efficient overall infra.
Maya (PM): Tradeoff Y: Reserved pools -> stronger guarantees, easier SLO math, higher infra cost.
Priya (Finance): I'll run a sensitivity model comparing 5, 10, 20% attach rates across customer size buckets and include idle GPU amortization.
Jules (Sales): market note: mid-market customers prefer simple pricing. enterprise OK with dedicated capacity if SLA-backed.
Owen (Legal): include data residency checklist if reserved pools are customer-VPC. KMS/HSM, audit logs, and certs need to be called out.
Ibrahim (SRE): telemetry needs: route_id, addon_version, peak_window_id, p95_latency_ms, success_count, total_count. make addon_version required.
Maya (PM): Benches & metrics for pilot: internal staging test showing P95 <120ms for 95% of routes over 24h simulated peaks.
Jules (Sales): naming brainstorm: "Fastlane Seats", "PeakShield", "BurstGuard". will test in pilot messaging.
Priya (Finance): credit language: auto-credit within next billing cycle upon confirmed breach; require 3rd-party arb only if disputed.
Owen (Legal): add explicit termination & migration clauses for reserved pools. customers must agree to lead time for deprovisioning.
Maya (PM): next steps: - Ibrahim to write short design doc + config example (1 sprint) - Priya to model pricing scenarios - Owen to draft addendum template - Jules to recruit pilot candidates.
Ibrahim (SRE): sample config (proto):
```
burst_priority:
  enabled: true
  mode: shared # options: shared | reserved
  peak_windows: ["00:00-02:00 UTC", "15:00-16:00 UTC"]
  vip_header: "x-customer-burst"
  fallback: allow_to_standard_pool: true
```
Maya (PM): keep configs small and sane. thanks all  logging this thread to roadmap and attaching to Q3 initiative.
Notify-bot: reminder: roadmap sync Thu 3pm to review pilot list.
Jules (Sales): chasing customer Z for pilot confirmation. will update thread when they reply.
Maya (PM): closing thread for now.
